messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth  who to disable grey background
parts:
Hi Peter,

The shaded region you want to get rid of is a confidence interval. To do so,

...+ geom_smooth(se=FALSE)


Check ?stat_smooth for more details...



Adam Loveland
